execution_policy: One primary review task and at most one bivariate task, serially under existing locks. Remaining budget is reserve, not permission for automatic expansion.

priorities.title: Check binary64 hypot special-test input selection
priorities.reason: Upstream 2b22bd62 reduced the default count and changed the seed/iteration structure.
priorities.next_action: Compare deterministic case classes and streams at equal budgets. Propose a compact deterministic input or fixture only if a meaningful difference is demonstrated.
priorities.deliverable: Before/after input-selection receipt and a conditional regression candidate.
priorities.acceptance: Separate a measured change in selected cases from loss of mathematical coverage.
priorities.stop: Stop at the card budget, missing comparable baseline, or a superseding change.
priorities.dependency: Pinned binary64 hypot check_special source and one available bivariate slot.
priorities.change: New source change inventoried. No regression or lost case claimed.

priorities.title: Bind contracted asin operations to the range proof
priorities.reason: Strict graph is certified. Fast-contraction probes are finite.
priorities.next_action: Inspect one pinned v3 compiler graph for fusions that change high/low residual identities. Extend the enclosure or name the first unsupported sequence.
priorities.deliverable: One compiler-graph binding and a replayable range bound or explicit gap.
priorities.acceptance: Bind emitted operations and rounding model before extending the proof scope.
priorities.stop: Stop at the card budget, unbound operation, or a changed source.
priorities.dependency: Pinned asin.c, documented strict certificate and a concrete v3 toolchain.
priorities.change: The original P2 range premises closed under strict semantics. A reachable negative signed index has a comment-only candidate.

priorities.title: Exact bivariate regressions: move beyond the two hypot midpoint families
priorities.reason: Both sides of the restricted hypot midpoint now have small certified examples. Preserve the missing archive work and try a different pow hypothesis.
priorities.next_action: Design an exact comparator for positive normal pow(x,3/2) by comparing x cubed with squared dyadic rounding boundaries. First certify a bounded sample and controls; no general pow runner qualification or altered exponent sweep.
priorities.deliverable: One bounded exact pow reference sample, or a precise feasibility limit. Keep angular/import checkpoints separate.
priorities.acceptance: Exact input decoding, positive/negative controls and bounds; values, flags and errno separate. Table verification does not regenerate a completeness census. No new bug or novelty claim from a hard-but-correct case.
priorities.stop: Stop on a failed control or cap. Recheck archive availability at the next checkpoint, report the blocker once and continue independent infrastructure work; do not silently drop the requested import.
priorities.dependency: Exact rational input decoding and integer comparisons; separately qualify any future pow library adapter. Archived research unavailable.
priorities.change: Both exact midpoint families now appear in upstream hypot.wc at 185b7dec. All 32 ordered pickup rows match. Preserve earlier numerical runs with their dates.
